description: Maharashtra Government fast-tracks its USD 11 billion AI Innovation City with Tata Group near Navi Mumbai International Airport.
body_lead: The Maharashtra Government is firming up a time-bound roadmap to expedite development of the Innovation City near Navi Mumbai International Airport, being built in partnership with the Tata Group. Kaustubh Dhavse, Chief Advisor (Investments & Strategy) to the Chief Minister of Maharashtra, announced this at the 6th Real Estate & Infrastructure Investors’ Summit (REIIS) 2026, organised by NAREDCO Maharashtra in Mumbai. The Maharashtra Government and Tata Group had earlier announced an $11 billion investment to build India’s first AI Innovation City, spread across 300 acres near the airport.
